segments.en: [This letter opens mid-sentence in the source text.]

…Who will urge himself to run to the most select Tzadik — who has the power… to cleave himself to the most select Tzadik — who has a most wondrous and most powerful power of attraction — to draw close and to bring all the world to Hashem Yisburach…

Who will urge himself to run to the most select Tzadik — who has a most wondrous and most powerful power of attraction — to draw and to bring close everything — the entire world — to Hashem Yisburach.
"In the beginning — before the eyes of all Israel" [Deuteronomy 34:12] — Torah 67, second part — Volume 2: The publicizing of the name of the Tzadik — in Likutay Halachos.
